Nostalgia Products - Mini Cupcake Maker - Unique countertop. Non-stick surface and lid. Holds seven cups at time. Convenient cord storage. Power and preheat indicator lights. Uses approximately 1/3 cup of batter for each cupcake. Cooking time: 5 - 7 min. Wattage: 1300 W. Warranty: 90 daysThe Cupcake Maker allows you to cook delicious cupcakes and other pastries at home without even turning on an oven! This unique countertop cupcake maker bakes up to seven cupcakes within five to seven minutes using your favorite recipe or mix. Preheat indicator light notifies when it's ready, then just pour the batter and the machine does the rest. Add your favorite toppings and you'll have perfect cupcakes that are great for any occasion. Unit is space saving and energy saving versus a regular oven. Plus, the non-stick baking plates make removal of the cupcakes easy and cleanup even easier. Great for snack time, party time or anytime, the cupcake maker makes a great gift.
